requirement: Voice review fixes: every question card read, a card's 'Huỷ' answers it, finishing what was said before Done/Enter, words held by Stop kept, replies kept when a work line is talked over, the spoken-reply rule bound to the spoken message, key health by the service's word with key generations, plan review back to Chat, 'thôi' and Chinese repeats, Chinese echo, Safari socket hints, relay idle and unavailable

oracle.invariant: 0 failures. A second card the same turn asks is read; a card answered before its line plays is not read; a question waiting behind a work line is asked as soon as it ends. Saying exactly a card's 'Huỷ' / 'Cancel' / '取消' answers the card and cancels nothing; 'Dừng lại.' still stops the work. The relay shows a new phrase alike the last one when speech came since, asks the service to finish on Done and waits, and writes a re-read never shown once; a page that stops sending audio, or answers no ping, is let go; a count that cannot be made ends as unavailable. Words held by Stop survive 12 s of quiet and the session closing, are not replaced by a cough, are sent by Send now, and are replaced by a new finished request that goes as usual; stuck words ask the service to finish and, unfinished, wait for Send now. Talking over a work line keeps the reply queued behind it, and its question is read; a spoken stop to an idle Tracy drops it. Words said in Voice are taken once by the step whose message they are; a message typed elsewhere never is; the page tells the host first and goes on if the host does not answer. Key health: a made-up key (400 invalid_api_key) refuses, quota_exceeded only limits, a bare 401 says nothing; a key saved during a probe drops the old result and tries the new key; a probe does not clear a limit real readings met. A plan waiting on review: Tracy says it, steers nothing, and goes to Chat; the window alone is not proof. 'Thôi' alone stops Tracy, 'Ok thôi' is listening; repeated Chinese 'yes' is listening; Chinese echo is caught per character; the socket URL keeps its hints without URLSearchParams.size; a one-word answer after Say it again is sent; pausing as speech begins opens no session. A card's choice said in the other Vietnamese tone spelling ('Huỷ' to a card labelled 'Hủy') still picks it; Voice pressed with a plan already waiting says so once the voice is on, then goes to Chat. An audio-idle callback that runs before its clock deadline rearms for the remaining time instead of leaving the session open.
